baseline.method: serial SBEngine.generate, 3 no-cache runs per row (no warm-up), per-stage p50 from the onProgress marks (stageDurations), guides.build / guides.validate via the SBGuides probe

warm720.machine: 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-11800H @ 2.30GHz (16 threads, 62.5 GiB), node v26.7.0

phaseA.machine: 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-11800H @ 2.30GHz (16 threads, 62.5 GiB), node v26.7.0
phaseA.method: serial SBEngine.generate, 3 no-cache runs per row (no warm-up), per-stage p50 from the onProgress marks (stageDurations), guides.build / guides.validate via the SBGuides probe
phaseA.gate: Phase A gate (plan F.6, after F3-F8): serial fab4096 p50 11996 ms (baseline 25306 ms; plan expectation 11-13 s), draft720 p50 1210 ms (baseline 3287 ms). F8 note: cropping the draft change overlays to the change bounding box is output-identical (oracle tests) but did not measurably speed them up on the bench art or the alpha.3 scene: the bounding boxes cover ~85 % of the raster (scattered changes) and the overlay time is dominated by fromPixelLoops/union/normalize of the many small change regions (per warm 720 run on the realistic family: ~190-200 ms both before and after; trace ~40 ms of it). The diff pass is fused (one pass, row memcpy crop). Further overlay gains need the KI-B1 normalize work (F18/G4.4).

phaseB.task: F11 (S1) coordinator worker, SBPool, handshake, progress, acceptResult
phaseB.machine: 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-11800H @ 2.30GHz (16 threads), node v26.7.0, 1-min load 5.9-6.7
phaseB.method: one pooled fab4096 run (user12 project, 4096 x 3084 source, 3985 x 3000 raster) through SBPool + test/node_worker_shim.js: coordinator + P = SBPool.helperCount(16) = 8 helpers, source posted once, no cache; main-thread event-loop delay with perf_hooks.monitorEventLoopDelay (5 ms resolution) during the run as the Node analogue of the long-task recorder; receipt path = v8.deserialize + deepFreeze of the response on main (structured clone). Single run, not the bench large row (F13/F18 measure p50/p95).
phaseB.codecDecision: No Int32Array polygon codec: the receipt path of the largest fabrication response (deserialize + deepFreeze) is 34 ms in Node, under the 50 ms rule (F.2, F-R7); x1.2 for Chromium gives ~41 ms. setSnapshot and the preview render are DOM work and are measured in the browser by F16a (?bench=fab with SBPool.longTasks()).
phaseB.gate: Phase B gate (plan F.6, after F11): fabrication runs in the coordinator with any pool size (P = 0 and 2 in the F11 tests, P = 8 in this run); in Node the main thread's longest event-loop block during the 12 Mpx pooled run is 13.5 ms. The in-app browser figure (PerformanceObserver longtask) needs the F15 app wiring and is recorded by F16a.

final.command: node test/bench.js large --only user12 --pool 0,1,8 --record  (then: --pool 0,8 --rows fab25 --runs 1 --record for the 25 Mpx memory row; in-app ?bench=fab in Chromium on the i7 for the S2 browser figure, the long-task maximum and the estBytes ledger peak)
final.reason: The F18 commit adds the measurement (bench.js benchUser12Final: --pool list, per-pool rows, geometryHash equality, process RSS/arrayBuffers peaks and the coordinator estBytes ledger peak) but does not run it: the run instructions for this task exclude the long large-image benchmark. A separate measurement run fills `final` (status becomes "measured"; --record keeps kiB1, kiConnPerf and browser).
